rules.note: Standard adult dosing is every 12 hours; other renal-adjusted intervals (q18h, q24h) are not included here.

Take ciprofloxacin at least 2 hours before or 6 hours after multivalent cation-containing drugs. S14 also states the same windows for magnesium/aluminum antacids, and S14 allows taking ciprofloxacin with a meal containing these products.
